# Skinstric AI - Project Instructions

## Technology Stack
- React with Vite
- JavaScript and JSX
- Tailwind CSS v4
- ESLint
- Git and GitHub
- Vercel for deployment

Do not change the technology stack or introduce additional dependencies without explicit approval.

## Project Scope
- Implement only the explicit Skinstric AI internship requirements.
- Follow the Skinstric Internship Figma designs, not the Skinstric Full Project designs.
- Do not add optional features, unnecessary animations, or additional functionality.
- Avoid overengineering and unnecessary abstractions.
- Prioritize completing the required functionality accurately and efficiently.

## Styling and Design
- Use Tailwind CSS utility classes for styling.
- Do not introduce separate component CSS files, inline styles, or additional styling frameworks.
- Match Figma typography, colors, spacing, and layout.
- Support desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes.
- Do not substitute fonts, assets, or design elements without approval.

## Code Quality
- Write clean, readable, maintainable code.
- Use functional React components and hooks.
- Create reusable components where appropriate.
- Use descriptive variable, function, and component names.
- Use semantic HTML and accessible controls.
- Follow the existing project conventions.
- Avoid unnecessary comments, duplicated code, and unused imports.

## Development Workflow
- Inspect existing files before making changes.
- Work on one small, focused task at a time.
- Only modify files relevant to the current task.
- Preserve existing working functionality.
- Do not refactor unrelated code.
- Ask for clarification when requirements are unclear.
- Explain proposed changes briefly.
- Identify assumptions, limitations, and unresolved issues.
- Allow changes to be reviewed and tested before proceeding.

## API Integration
- Follow the provided internship API documentation exactly.
- Use the specified endpoints, request methods, and payload formats.
- Include required input validation and error handling.
- Do not introduce additional backend services.

## Deployment
- Maintain compatibility with Vercel.
- Do not commit credentials, secrets, or sensitive information.
